title: fix(usage): report prompt cache-write tokens in /account/usage
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Fixed `/account/usage` records omitting prompt cache-write tokens even though billing counted them. Tinybird now carries `token_count_prompt_cache_write` into `input_cache_write_tokens`, defaulting to 0, and the Enter API returns the field in JSON and OpenAPI schemas and as a CSV column immediately after `input_cached_tokens`. The SDK adds `UsageRecord.input_cache_write_tokens`, while `polli usage` includes cache writes in `tokens_in` so its total matches billed usage; the CLI version bumps to 0.1.35. The API docs list the new field and clarify that `input_cached_tokens` counts cache reads.
